What really happens behind the walls of the embassy when the doors close and the visa applications stop coming?

It's time to go beyond the queues, interviews, and hilarious immigration encounters to explore the untold stories of our favourite visa officers!

VISA ON ARRIVAL: THE MOVIE takes the world of the popular Accelerate TV series to a whole new level, offering a glimpse into the personal lives, hidden ambitions, complicated relationships, and unexpected drama of the people who make the embassy tick.
